laws.rule: Under the Freedom Camping Act 2011, freedom camping means camping outside a designated campground, within 200 m of a road or area reachable by motor vehicle, or within 200 m of the sea or harbour low-water line, using a vehicle, tent or other temporary structure. On public conservation land it is allowed except where prohibited or restricted: not in DOC scenic or recreation reserves without a designated campsite, not generally near Great Walks tracks, and some sites are for certified self-contained vehicles only or have night limits. Rules: obey signs, take away waste including human waste, light no fires. From 7 June 2026 a 'green warrant' card must be displayed at self-contained-only sites, and vehicles with a portable toilet can no longer be certified. No freedom camping with dogs in national parks. Council bylaws are not checked here.
laws.penalty_signal: Fines may apply; amounts are published by the Ministry of Business, Innovation and Employment (not read here).

laws.rule: Complete a Border Cash Report if you carry NZ$10,000 or more in cash (or the foreign equivalent, including bearer instruments) into or out of New Zealand. NZ$10,000 is about A$8,010 (RBA 30 Oct 2026: A$1 = NZD 1.2480).
laws.penalty_signal: Not reporting, or avoiding the report, can mean a fine, imprisonment or the cash being seized

laws.rule: Duty-free limits for travellers: 4.5 litres of wine or beer, plus 3 bottles of spirits or liqueur (each up to 1.125 litres). Tobacco: 50 cigarettes, or 50 grams of cigars or tobacco products, or 50 grams of a mix. Anything over must be declared and has duty and GST paid on the excess. Concessions do not cover goods carried for another person or for sale. Combined overseas purchases over NZ$700 (about A$560) are also declared.
laws.penalty_signal: Undeclared tobacco or alcohol over the limit can be penalised

laws.rule: Prescription medicines (not containing controlled drugs) must come in their original packaging with a copy of the prescription or a doctor's letter, and no more than three months of supply (six months for an oral contraceptive). Declare them on the NZ Traveller Declaration if you carry more than three months of supply or they are not prescribed to you or a family member. Controlled drugs have separate, stricter requirements.

baseline_unverified.host_unlock: No immigration sponsor is required. A host adds value by documenting the invitation, role, dates, venue, fee or expenses, tax classification and any professional or event permissions.
baseline_unverified.before_departure: Travel on the Australian passport. Complete the free New Zealand Traveller Declaration from 24 hours before the journey begins. If character eligibility is uncertain, resolve it with Immigration New Zealand before flying.
baseline_unverified.useful_stay: The resident visa permits an indefinite stay. It expires on departure unless travel conditions have been varied; this usually does not prevent a qualifying Australian citizen receiving a fresh resident visa on a later arrival.
baseline_unverified.from: Luke's earlier precursor notes; not verified against an official source and not an authority. Kept because no official page covers this point yet.
